title: The Hope about the Pen Pal
youtube_title: The Hope about the Pen Pal | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Listening all the way through is a gift you can give today.
summary: At a kitchen table before breakfast, chairs close, Mama begins to tell Milo about hope about a pen pal, said carefully. Milo wants to interrupt with bigger news, but listens all the way to the last sentence, asks one real question, and only then shares something small of their own.
